title: RDA DMP Common Standard Schema
description: JSON Schema for the RDA DMP Common Standard v1.0, updated to include the DMPRoadmap and Belnet extensions.

validation_topics.title: The Belnet Extension Validation Topics Schema
validation_topics.description: The Belnet extension to support different validation topics for a DMP.

modified.title: The Belnet Extension Validation Topics Modified Schema
modified.description: The date and time when the validation topics were last modified.

organization.title: The Belnet Extension Organization Schema
organization.description: The organization(s) for which the validation topics lists are defined.

org_id.title: The Belnet Extension Organization Identifier Schema
org_id.description: The unique identifier of the organization.

org_name.title: The Belnet Extension Organization Name Schema
org_name.description: The full name of the organization.

org_abbreviation.title: The Belnet Extension Organization Abbreviation Schema

current_list.title: The Belnet Extension Validation Topics Current List Schema
current_list.description: The current allowed list of DMP validation topics for this organization, ordered from start to finish.

enum.title: The Belnet Extension Validation Topics Current List Enum Schema
enum.description: With `enum` indicate this is a fixed list of values.

items.title: The Belnet Extension Validation Topics Current List Enum Items Schema
items.description: The items in this list. A space is allowed, but no other special characters.

full_list.title: The Belnet Extension Validation Topics Full List Schema
full_list.description: The complete list of DMP validation topics for this organization, always including the default topics and the deprecated topics, ordered from start to finish.

enum.title: The Belnet Extension Validation Topics Full List Enum Schema
enum.description: With `enum` indicate this is a fixed list of values.

items.title: The Belnet Extension Validation Topics Full List Enum Items Schema
items.description: The items in this list. A space is allowed, but no other special characters.
